headline: The cabinet remembers — Contra ranks your best runs
lede: Never-dry fired again on Contra (the third rung tonight after the seat carry and the popups) and found the memory gap: HI rode live in the HUD but the page forgot everything else. TOP SOLDIERS now keeps your five best runs — score plus the LOOP badge the run rode — on the attract title, and a fall that takes the crown lights NEW RECORD on the salute band with a rising triad answering the gameover fall.

notes.text: Honest gates all round: the bank rides HI's own end-of-run gate so the attract autopilot can never fill the board with demo gold; a zero-score fall is refused by the sim law and writes nothing — even to storage — and a corrupt store drops its bad rows instead of trusting them (9 static + 5 live legs pin it, named mutant hall-forget dies).

Referee-clean by construction: hallAdd/hallRead are pure data laws over {score, loop, t} that take arrays, never gs — zero gs.r, zero hash surface, banking beside a live run leaves the world hash byte-identical.
Phone-first placement: the first screenshot caught the d-pad eating the bottom-left, so the board sits top-right under the HUD — readable where the thumbs are not.

Fidelity note (#237): Contra's exact attract-table lettering isn't documented in the repo — the era-typical Konami board (1st/2nd/3rd, gold scores) is the claim; the loop badge is this game's own ladder (#2894) given a memory.

look.text: Contra — fall once, then see your name in gold
